summary: PR 7525 added source support for a reserved Azure Local test environment with shared fixtures, without activating it. It merged on 2026-10-13 after repeated ready-for-review cycles and CodeQL comments.
proposed: The body asks for reserved test subscriptions for Azure Local modules and shared fixture infrastructure so tests need not rebuild all dependencies cold.
changed: The body describes partitioning the subscription pool by an optional tag and seven module-root mappings in .reserved-test-subscriptions.json, failing before allocation on malformed or missing reserved pools. It adds a manual preparation workflow, serializes preparation, tests and cleanup on the shared environment, and reuses shared dependencies in fourteen non-cluster fixtures while keeping cold paths. Feature deltas show new optional test parameters described as validated persistent dependencies from reserved Azure Local CI, and a new test-key-vault.bicep template. Review activity was three bot reviews; the shown comments are CodeQL 'Excessive Secrets Exposure' warnings about toJSON(secrets).
shipped: Merged 2026-10-13 as commit 806ee4c, changing workflows and actions, .reserved-test-subscriptions.json, the azure-stack-hci and hybrid-container-service test fixtures, and utilities/e2e-template-assets. The slice shows no human review before merge.
